question: How can the pure powers also be related to terrible forms and cosmic functions?
premises: The powers are the source of the terrible and more terrible forms.
Because they are their source, they are of that nature as well.
Their forms operate in creation, maintenance, dissolution, and beyond those three conditions.
inference: The same powers appear as benign in essence yet also manifest as fierce forms and as the basis of the three cosmic acts and their transcendence.
uncertainties: The verse compresses several doctrinal relations into a short statement.
plain_english: Because they are the source of the terrible and more terrible forms, they are also of that nature, appearing in creation, maintenance, dissolution, and in the transcendence of those three conditions.
